record.paper_title: Formal languages and arithmetic theories: recent results and open problems
record.context_brief: Decidability of concatenation plus numeric value
record.original_question: Let T_nc be the existential two-sorted string/natural-number constraint theory in which the available string operation is concatenation and the available conversion from strings to numbers is the function sn that maps a binary string to the natural number it represents. Is the existential theory of T_nc decidable?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9. Determine the decidability of the existential theory of Tnc.
the existential fragment of Tnc in which only the concatenation operator and sn function are present.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider a two-sorted first-order language with a string sort (over the binary alphabet {0,1}) and a natural-number sort. The string sort is equipped with the binary concatenation operation ·, and there is a function symbol sn from strings to natural numbers, where sn(w) denotes the natural number whose standard binary representation is the string w (with sn(ε)=0). On the natural-number sort, equip the language with the constants 0 and 1, the operations of addition and multiplication, and the order relation. Let T_nc denote the two-sorted theory of (Σ*, ℕ) in this signature, restricted so that the only string operation present is concatenation and the only conversion symbol from strings to numbers is sn. Determine whether the existential fragment of T_nc is decidable: that is, decide whether there exists an algorithm that, given an existential sentence ∃x₁…∃xₘ φ (with quantifiers ranging over either sort and φ quantifier-free in the signature above), determines whether the sentence holds in the intended model.
artifact.status_search_result: A search did not turn up any resolution of the decidability of the existential theory combining concatenation with the binary string-to-number conversion function sn. Related results show that the pure existential theory of concatenation is decidable, while extensions by length or equal-length predicates lead to undecidability or open problems, but the specific question for T_nc appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the Decidability and Expressive Power of Several Theories Based on String Constraints
status_evidence.snippet: Examines decidability and expressive power of theories with concatenation, length, letter-count, and linear arithmetic; related extensions remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies decidability of string-constraint theories combining concatenation with numeric operations; the specific existential theory T_nc is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Definability in the Existential Theory of Concatenation and Undecidable Extensions of this Theory
status_evidence.snippet: The existential theory of concatenation is decidable; certain extensions become undecidable.
status_evidence.claim: Pure existential concatenation is decidable, but extensions by additional predicates may be undecidable; status of sn extension not established here.
